title: Astratch Addon info.yaml
description: Schema for an Astratch addon's info.yaml (plugin metadata). CI validates every addon against this schema.

id.description: Unique addon id (must match its directory name)

version.description: Semantic version of the current release

icon.description: Path to the addon icon, e.g. assets/icon.svg

typescript.description: True if the source is TypeScript/JSX (compiled by CI)

defaultEnabled.description: Whether the addon is enabled by default on first install

version.description: Semver range of compatible Astratch versions (e.g. ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0")

files.description: Additional JS files to include in the release (for pure JS addons with multiple files). Supports file paths and directory paths (trailing /). Entry point is always included.
